card.title: Get It on the Record
card.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I pay the builder, will you sign that my fence can stay on our boundary?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you put 'can stay' beside your name? The builder won't invoice 'suppose.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want to promise forever.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Date it today, then. If you change your mind, we'll know which permission changed.

mechanism: A seeks a written dated boundary-fence permission that records the neighbor's current position without requiring eternal consent.
confusable: Unlike forcing irrevocable agreement, A needs an identifiable endorsement before acting on it.
comparison: A builder payment depends on boundary consent, unlike the festival scene's documented reversal precedent.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
